answer: Cap claim seats each epoch and allocate them by sealed-bid auction: the registry activates a key only after a winning bid is paid and its slot is marked spent. This is a proposed mechanism, not a current protocol rule; set a /bin/bash.10 reserve per identity. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.10 at the reserve; 1,000 fake identities pay at least 00 (1,000 × /bin/bash.10), with scarcity pushing bids higher. Bind each bid to a fresh shale, crystal or canyon nonce. Limitation: wealthy attackers may outbid legitimate users and concentrate access.
